participation.context: Came out of the part and kept the column empty of a figure.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Closed the play and did not ask the part's name.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Carried the book in with the K and without a number.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

story.body: You finished the play, refused a name and a number, and went through.

title: Left the part and went to the reckoning

participation.context: Counted twenty-two shillings and refused to pay either debt with them.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the share, left both debts standing, and did not bring the coffer down.
participation.name: John Heminges

participation.context: Kept the K without a digit and refused a new stock figure.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Reported her own stair and brought no Rose receipt.
participation.name: Goodwife Margery Pell

participation.context: Asked after his lines, stayed on you, and got no number.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You accepted the share, kept it off the gown and off Edith's eight, and went home with the K still numberless.

title: Took twenty-two shillings at the reckoning

story.body: You repeated the unpaid page and stopped. The share stayed a share.

title: Repeated the twenty-two shillings and stopped
